title: Wonderful experience just outside of Barcelona
text:
Planned a surprise trip here and coordinated everything with Viator and the winery ahead of time. Everything was perfect. Beautiful vineyard, great breakfast, tasting and tour after. This is a very scenic location just outside of Barcelona and we had the entire winery to ourselves.

Would highly recommend this tour or other tours to this winery to anyone interested in wine and visiting Barcelona.
author: Edward_S

title: Wonderful
text: The wine, food, tour were all fantastic! The views were spectacular! The information was  very informative.
author: Denise_T

title: A must do!
text: Fabulous experience from start to finish. Montse picked us up at the cruise ship terminal and we had a quick 20 minute drive to the winery. We learned about the winery (bouquet d'alella), had a traditional Catalan breakfast with  different wines produced at the winery. We toured the vineyard and ended the tasting with an espresso and a case of wine to ship home!
author: Terri_L

title: A nice introduction to the Alella appellation
text:
A very pleasant visit to a small vineyard 30 minutes north of Barcelona in the Alella appellation. Never heard of it? It only has 7 vineyards in it... Anna, our host is very pleasant and knowledgeable about wine (she is a sommelier), so it made the visit extra nice - it was not a mass tourist attraction but truly a visit for wine lovers who are curious and who can appreciate wine and all that goes with it. 

We were picked up in a hotel in a huge van and driven to the vineyard - to our surprise there was nobody else in the van and the breakfast was solely for the two of us. Price of this tour
author: pfpha

title: Must do experiencel
text:
Warm, friendly reception by the host at the winery. Very nice wines. 
Professional driver and immaculate vehicle.
author: Rosemary_B

title: 5 star experience of beauty and taste
text: This is a 5 star experience. Short drive from Barcelona center and you are in the most beautiful place. Tasting interesting wines and having a lovely brunch with a fantastic view to the Sea. Afterwards we had a nice walk in the vineyards and the winery with the host. The host is really nice and so was Melanie from Barcelona Discovery. All in all we highly recommend the tour (NB: we ordered 12 bottles of wine while on-site and they arrived in Denmark 4 days later, so now we can extend the experience over the coming weeks)
author: rolfthansen
